text:
Jamie: Quick mobile UX sync — saw a weird reflow on foldable when the notifications drawer opens over the runs table. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/xyz. Not sure if this is breakpoint logic or z-index/safe-area interaction.
Noah: Repro'd on Pixel Fold emulator. Table rows shift up and table header disappears under the drawer. Seems like height calc uses window.innerHeight which changes on fold.
Lee: We set the drawer to position:fixed and animate translateY. On fold the inset bottom/safe-area is different so the table gets a smaller layout viewport.
Lee: Minimal repro CSS: ```css
.drawer { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; transform: translateY(0); }
.table-wrap { height: calc(100vh - var(--header-height)); overflow: auto; }
```
Lee: Using 100vh here is the suspect on foldables/phone keyboard. We should switch to env(safe-area-inset-bottom) aware calc or use JS layout observer.
Olga: Accessibility nits: when drawer opens keyboard focus is moved visually but the focus ring gets clipped by drawer overlay. Also selected table row contrast when highlighted (#4A90E2 on white) fails AA for 14px body text. Need stronger accent or add a focus outline.
Jamie: Good call. For copy: the empty state currently says "No results" — product asked to make it clearer: change to "No matching runs" and add a short hint about filters.
Noah: Also noticed sticky filters stop being sticky when drawer open -> they jump under header. Could be z-index. Suggest we refactor sticky to use position:sticky inside a bounded container rather than global fixed header hack.
Lee: I can try replacing 100vh with: ```js
const viewportHeight = window.visualViewport ? window.visualViewport.height : window.innerHeight;
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--vh', `${viewportHeight}px`);
// then height: calc(var(--vh) - var(--header-height))
```
Lee: That should avoid fold/unfold flicker.
Olga: Also request: add skip-to-content link for drawer so keyboard users can quickly jump to table rows after opening. And ensure aria-hidden on background content while drawer is active.
Jamie: UX decision needed: on small foldable widths do we collapse to single-column cards for runs or keep the table and allow horizontal scroll? Product leaning to preserve table for power users but allow compact row layout at <360px width.
Noah: Ok let's do compact rows below 360px and table above. Please add aQA checklist: foldable portrait + landscape, iPhone SE, Pixel 7a, VoiceOver + TalkBack. @QA Bot can you run the responsive regression tests and flag visual diffs?
QA Bot: Added test job "runs-table-drawer-foldable" to the canary suite. Will run on next submit.
Lee: I'll open a PR with the --vh fix + improved focus outline + copy tweak. Will include screenshots and before/after.
Olga: Thanks — include accessibility checklist in PR description so reviewers can tick off VoiceOver/TalkBack tests.
Noah: Prioritization: treat this as P2 for the next sprint unless QA sees a blocking regression.
deploy-bot: canary build queued for branch "fix/foldable-drawer-vh". Canary id: cb-202311-7789.
Jamie: Sweet — thanks team, tagging this for design review on Thursday.
